title: XQ Squad EGM consumer configuration
description: Consumer-owned Elephant-Goldfish Model settings for this repository. intake_policy applies only after a completed Goldfish intake review writes a report. Incomplete reviews and fresh-context failures always end BLOCKED. null means the owner has not chosen yet — the Lead must ask and must not pick a policy. "block": any EGM blocker (🔴) finding ends intake BLOCKED; major/nit findings are reported but do not block. "warn": all findings are recorded and intake continues.

egm_package_version.description: Pinned EGM package version vendored under egm_root.

egm_root.description: Repository-relative path to the vendored EGM Cursor package.

spec_dir.description: Directory of approved feature specs (docs/designs by default).

artifact_dir.description: Directory for EGM review and drift reports. Never write into the plugin tree.

intake_policy.description: How the Lead treats a completed intake review with blocker findings. null = unset (BLOCKED until set).
